messages:
morgan: Quick idea before rollout: add a 'grace-mode' action in the rollout header. It's like a short-lived safety hold that routes to a cheaper model but clearly labeled.
elaine: Sounds good. Key must-haves: who acted, reason (required), TTL, and an audit event that's replayable.
sam: Agreed. Also need dry-run/simulate so PMs can see 'would-grace' without touching traffic. UI should show cost delta and rough perf delta.
kai: UX: topbar button 'Enter grace-mode' -> small modal: fallback model selector, TTL, reason, checkbox: run simulation first. Show cost delta estimate.
morgan: Telemetry tags to emit: grace.v1.trigger=(auto|operator|simulate), grace.v1.fallback, grace.v1.cost_delta_usd. Emit grace.v1.expired on TTL expiry.
infra-bot: deploy: canary started for replies-v3 -> 5%
elaine: Audit event format (single-line): "event:grace.apply;actor:morgan;route:/reply;from:reply-large;to:reply-small;ttl_s:1800;reason:mitigating 5xx;cost_delta_hr:-10.5;ts:1779000200"
sam: Backend: persist operator events append-only. TTL expiry must generate its own audit event. Operator cancel is explicit.
kai: Block apply if fallback quota/capacity missing and show remediation link. For MVP: single fallback target only. Chains v2.
morgan: API: POST /rollouts/{id}/grace-actions {action:apply|simulate|cancel, fallback, ttl_s, reason}. Return snapshot hashes and cost_estimate.
elaine: I'll own trigger defs and migration notes. Sam will write telemetry + API RFC. Morgan will mock a slim modal. Ship MVP: simulate + apply-with-audit + TTL.
